newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi, Sona, building India auto parts plant.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi, Sona, building India auto parts plant.

text.p: Mitsubishi Materials Corp said on Wednesday that its joint venture with India's Sona Steering Systems Ltd had begun construction of a precision-forged auto parts plant near New Delhi.
The 1.2 billion yen plant is scheduled for completion at the end of this year, with production to begin in April 1998, the company said.
The plant will produce precision-forged differential gears and synchroniser rings for manual transmissions, with annual sales expected to reach 1.4 billion yen after five years of operation.

The joint venture, Sona-Okegawa Precision Forgings Ltd, was formed last July and is owned 45 percent by Sona Steering, 26.25 percent by Mitsubishi Materials, and 3.75 percent by Japanese trade house Mitsubishi Corp.
The remaining 25 percent will be taken up by investment banks, although the details have yet to be decided, the company said.
